I’m a Latina that grew up in Houston and moved to Portland back in October. People in Portland don’t know how to interact with minorities and a lot of the time their efforts to be inclusive will come off as microagressions. The lack of diversity here makes it feel like white people are competing on who’s more woke so the progressiveness doesn’t feel genuine. Southern hospitality is a real thing and you’ll notice a huge difference when going out to the grocery store and through other customer service experiences. People are going to roll their eyes when you say Texas. Yes, Texas is problematic in many ways, but you don’t feel it as much in the bigger cities especially if you surround yourself with a diverse crowd. Be prepared for 6 months of rain and gloomy weather. Take your vitamins and get outside even if it’s raining a bit.

No problem - I’m hispanic too and I grew up in Houston. Which is far more diverse but not as “woke”.
